第31章 蔡怡农：这小子勾引我啊！！-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

跟矮大紧点头示意一下，魏沐大步走进录音棚。

这五首歌都是小样，还没有伴奏，只能先用吉他顶着。

坐在木质椅子上，拨动一下琴弦，清了下嗓子，熟悉的旋律在他脑海中回荡，轻声唱道。

“把昨天都作废

现在你在我眼前

我想爱请给我机会

如果我错了也承担

........

我说过我不闪躲

我非要这么做

讲不听也偏要爱

更努力爱让你明白

.........”

开头便是王炸歌曲《偏爱》

魏沐没打算藏着掖着，他写了五首歌，总不能把五首歌全部唱一遍吧？

没必要。

一首歌定生死，《偏爱》还不够？

这首歌的原唱是湾湾歌手张芸京，她的嗓音因独特的中性特质被广泛讨论。

老实说，不少人表示第一次听差点以为是男生唱的。

一曲唱罢，魏沐看向录音棚隔音玻璃外的宋柯，后者已经眼圈泛红。

不是，一首歌而已，至于这么激动？

他想象过各种反应，没想到老宋会这样。

是不是我给他的压力太大了？

想想也不可能，老宋好歹是音乐圈大佬级别人物，不会的。

“我不怕谁嘲笑我极端，相信自己的直觉，顽固的人不喊累。爱上你我不撤退。这词写的太好了。为了爱情不顾一切吗？”

矮大紧嘴里反复念叨着这句词，连连感叹。

昨天机场的那句话只是随意为之，如果记者再问他，他的回答还是一样。

这小子就是天才歌手。

“怎么样？”

魏沐走出来，随手把吉他放在地上。

矮大紧嘿嘿一笑，视线停留在好搭档的脸上，眼神中带着一丝幸灾乐祸。

在这小子来之前，他们俩就商量好了，尽量压一压，不能让他太嚣张。

他来唱黑脸，宋柯唱红脸，俩人一唱一和，争取在合同谈判上取得上风。

现在嘛....这首歌一出，实在挑不出毛病。

想压价都不知道怎么下手。

宋柯沉默了一会，缓缓开口。

“你这首歌像是为电视剧写的？”

不愧是知名音乐人。

原时空，《偏爱》这首歌并不是为《仙剑奇侠传三》量身定做。

它是歌手张芸京2009年首张专辑《破天荒》的主打歌曲。

After nodding with Gao Dagen, Wei Mu strode into the recording studio.

These five songs are all demos, and there is no accompaniment yet, so I can only listen to them on the guitar first.

Sitting on a wooden chair, he plucked the strings and cleared his throat. A familiar melody echoed in his mind and he sang softly.

"Void yesterday

now you are in front of me

I want love please give me a chance

I'll take responsibility if I'm wrong

........

I said I won't dodge

I have to do this

Even if you don’t listen, you still want to love.

Love harder to make you understand

....."

It starts with Wang Zha's song "Preference"

Wei Mu didn't intend to hide it. He wrote five songs. He couldn't sing all five songs, right?

No need.

One song determines life and death, isn't "Preference" enough?

The original singer of this song is Wanwan singer Zhang Yunjing. Her voice has been widely discussed for its unique androgynous qualities.

To be honest, many people said that they almost thought it was sung by a boy when they first heard it.

After singing the song, Wei Mu looked at Song Ke outside the soundproof glass of the recording studio, whose eyes were already red.

No, it’s just a song. Why are you so excited?

He had imagined various reactions, but he never expected Lao Song to be like this.

Did I put too much pressure on him?

It's impossible even if you think about it. Lao Song is a big-shot figure in the music industry, so he can't.

"I'm not afraid of anyone laughing at me for being extreme. I trust my own intuition. A stubborn person doesn't cry tired. When I fall in love with you, I won't retreat. This word is so well written. Do you risk everything for love?"

Xiao Daqian kept repeating this sentence and sighed repeatedly.

What he said at the airport yesterday was just random. If reporters asked him again, his answer would still be the same.

This guy is a talented singer.

"How's it going?"

Wei Mu walked out and put the guitar on the ground.

Xiao Dajin chuckled, his eyes resting on his good partner's face, with a hint of schadenfreude in his eyes.

Before this kid came, the two of them had discussed it and tried to suppress him so as not to let him get too arrogant.

He comes to play the bad guy, and Song Ke plays the sweet guy. The two of them sing along and try to gain the upper hand in contract negotiations.

Now...as soon as this song came out, I really couldn’t fault it.

I don’t know where to start if I want to lower the price.

Song Ke was silent for a while and then spoke slowly.

"You think this song was written for a TV series?"

He is indeed a well-known musician.

In the original time and space, the song "Preference" was not tailor-made for "Legend of Sword and Fairy III".

It is the title song of singer Zhang Yunjing's 2009 debut album "Breaking Heaven".
